headline: Hiking the Iconic Pinnacles of the Trotternish Peninsula
reservation: No formal entry permits or reservations are required for the trail at this time. Visitors should verify local parking arrangements upon arrival, as site infrastructure is subject to change. Always check the official regional tourism site for the most current access status before your visit.

days.title: Trotternish Ridge Ascent

stops.name: Old Man of Storr
stops.detail: Trek the prominent path to reach the base of this basalt pinnacle for panoramic views of the Sound of Raasay.

days.driving: Allow 15-30 minutes each way from Portree; conditions vary
days.note: The ascent involves steep sections; pace yourself according to local weather changes.

intel.title: Trailhead Arrival
intel.text: The dedicated parking area is located on the A855 road. Evidence does not specify current fill times, so arrive early to ensure space.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: Cellular reception is not documented in the provided source evidence. Users must verify coverage with local providers and download offline maps before departure.

intel.title: Supply Points
intel.text: No fuel services are documented at the trailhead. Travelers should secure all necessary petrol and supplies in Portree before heading north.

intel.title: Seasonal Pace
intel.text: During peak summer months, the trail experiences its highest traffic volumes. Allow extra time for the walk up to meet the Old Man due to the incline.

intel.title: Path Conditions
intel.text: The route is a well-traveled walk, but specific path maintenance levels are not detailed in current records. Verify current trail alerts via official Isle of Skye tourism channels.

plan.arrival: Pick up your rental vehicle in Portree or arrive via local transfer. Check into local accommodation before driving the short distance north to the trailhead.
plan.vehicle: Standard passenger cars are suitable for the main roads, though travelers should check rental restrictions for island driving.
plan.goldenHour: Old Man of Storr viewpoint at sunrise for eastern light across the pinnacles, subject to seasonal visibility.
